newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's CST 1996 net 126.2 mln reais.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's CST 1996 net 126.2 mln reais.

text.p: Brazilian steelmaker Companhia Siderurgica de Tubarao, known as CST, has released the following 1996 earnings figures.
Note: The figures for net profit are in Brazilian reais, while sales and investment figures are in U.S. dollars.
In a statement, CST said 1996 was the fourth consecutive year it posted a net profit.
The company, which was privatized in 1992, has earned profits totalling $700 million between 1993 and the end of last year, it said.
CST also said it distributed 63.1 million reais in dividends in 1996, bringing to $230 million the total dividends it has paid out since its transfer to private hands.
Company sales last year of $894.7 million were off 4.7 percent from 1995, it added.

The statement added that CST's 1996 investments totalling $230 million would allow the firm to boost steel plates output to 4.5 million metric tons a year by 1998. The firm last year produced 3,365,000 tonnes last year, down 0.7 percent from 1995.
